scene.note: One caddy, written once in its header, holds screws, jewels or repairs, and never more than its limit.

steps.note: The caddy is written once, with the type of what it holds left open.
Kasimir makes a caddy with a limit and puts items in, one at a time.

value.label: comes out
values: yes or no for each item

steps.note: Each item is taken or refused, and the caddy can say how many it holds.
A body is written below the class, still in the header, where every file can see it.
Someone asks the caddy for the item at a place.

value.label: comes out
values: the item there, or a refusal

steps.note: The item comes back to be read, or the caddy refuses when nothing is there.
Kasimir hands over the repairs waiting their turn and the room on the shelf.
A caddy of repairs is made, and each repair is offered to it in order.

value.label: comes out
values: a caddy of repairs, no fuller than its limit

steps.note: The shelf gets the repairs that fit; the rest wait.
